style: set the scene in one or two plain sentences

candidates.angle: rajas binds the embodied being through attachment to action
candidates.evidence: कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् (through attachment to action, the embodied being)

candidates.angle: rajas is born of craving and attachment

candidates.evidence: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि (Know rajas as passion-born)

angle_en: Rajas binds the embodied being through attachment to action
angle_hi: रजोगुण कर्म की आसक्ति से शरीरधारी को बाँधता है

en.intro: Krishna continues his lesson on the three forces. He now names the restless force that keeps a person tied to action.
en.notice: Krishna names rajas as born from craving and attachment, and he says that force binds the embodied being through attachment to action.
en.next: Krishna goes on to name the third force, tamas, born of ignorance and sleep.
en.meaning: Know rajas as passion-born, born of craving and attachment. It binds the embodied being through attachment to action, O son of Kunti.

hi.intro: कृष्ण तीन गुणों पर अपनी शिक्षा जारी रखते हैं। अब वे उस बेचैन करने वाले गुण का नाम लेते हैं जो इंसान को कर्म से बाँधे रखता है।
hi.meaning: हे कुन्तीनन्दन, तृष्णा और आसक्ति से पैदा होने वाले रजोगुण को रागस्वरूप समझो। वह कर्म की आसक्ति से शरीरधारी को बाँधता है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि रजोगुण तृष्णा और आसक्ति से पैदा होता है और वह कर्म से आसक्ति के कारण शरीरधारी को बाँधता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब तीसरे गुण तमस का नाम लेते हैं जो अज्ञान से पैदा होता है।
